# Australian Financial Advisory

> Australian Financial Advisory (AFA) is a pre-insolvency assessment-and-referral advisory for Australian company directors facing ATO debt, Director Penalty Notice risk, cash-flow pressure, or a restructure or wind-down decision. AFA assesses the director's financial position, sets out the options in writing, and refers specialist execution work to appropriately licensed practitioners. Australian Financial Advisory Pty Ltd is not a registered insolvency practitioner, credit licensee, tax agent, registered liquidator, AFSL holder, or law firm. Based at 215 Brisbane Road, Biggera Waters QLD 4216 on the Gold Coast; serving Gold Coast, Brisbane, Sydney, Australia-wide.

Contact: (07) 2113 3069, info@australianfinancialadvisory.com.au. The first conversation is a free initial consultation: confidential, no cost, no obligation.

How AFA works: a free initial consultation, then an Options Assessment (a structured review of your financial position and the options available), then an Initial Advisory Report (a written report setting out your position, options and recommended next steps). Where a licensed specialist is needed, AFA introduces one from its network. Any next step is the director's decision.

- [ATO debt options](https://www.australianfinancialadvisory.com.au/reduce-debt): understanding an ATO debt position and the options that may be available, including payment plans through a registered tax agent.
- [Business restructure options](https://www.australianfinancialadvisory.com.au/restructure-your-business): whether Small Business Restructuring, voluntary administration or an informal arrangement may suit a company.
- [Administration and liquidation options](https://www.australianfinancialadvisory.com.au/administration-and-liquidation): what each formal process means for a director before committing.
- [Close or wind up a company](https://www.australianfinancialadvisory.com.au/close-company): solvent and insolvent closure paths and director duties.
- [Your options explained](https://www.australianfinancialadvisory.com.au/services): hub page linking every explainer and options page.
- [Small Business Restructuring explained](https://www.australianfinancialadvisory.com.au/services/small-business-restructure)
